name: Is Yatirim Menkul Degerler Anonim Sirketi
summary: Is Yatirim Menkul Degerler Anonim Sirketi provides capital market services to individual and corporate investors in Turkey and internationally. The company offers corporate finance services, including equity capital markets, mergers and acquisitions, and private sector advisory consisting of public equity offerings, private sector debt securities issuances, restructuring and strategic planning, project financing advisory and venture capital advisory. It provides fixed income securities; repo products; investment funds; foreign exchange products; warrants; and structured products, as well as services in stocks, derivatives, and international markets.
